serialization: single-command after precedence; status always bypasses busy, enabled tabs/end bypass busy, all other concurrent commands -> 'Agent is busy. Retry after the current command completes.'
userTabPolicy: reject with 'This is a user tab. Open its URL with new to work in the right agent pane.'
transport: Unix socket 0600 + UID check (Windows Chromium: owner-only named pipe). No TCP, no CDP port.
